title: A/R Summary: a Location sort returns to name order when one location is left
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and location B, with location A's name first in A to Z order.
  • Have three customers with open invoices on today's date: customer A only at location B, customer B only at location A and customer C only at location A, their names in A to Z order A, B, C.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Click the "Location" header.
  2. In the Location menu, untick location B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Location" is marked as the sorted column (a small arrow beside its heading).
  • Customer B and customer C (location A) are above customer A (location B).

Step 2:

  • The Location column is no longer shown.
  • Customer A is no longer listed.
  • The customer name column (the first column) is marked as the sorted column again: the report is back in its opening order, customer B then customer C.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S2-R7a: “If the report is sorted by Location and the Location column then hides (Story 6), whether the Location filter is narrowed to one location or a new as-of date leaves only one location in the list, the sort returns to the opening order (Story 1), so a sorted header is always visible.”
  • S2-R7: “The sort is kept while the user stays on the report: changing the as-of date, loading more rows by scrolling, and changing the customer, vendor, Past due or Location filter keep it, except as in S2-R7a.”
  • S6-R2: “The column is shown when two or more locations are ticked (All locations counts when the report's list has two or more) and hidden when one or none is ticked.”
  • S1-R7: “The column the report opened on is marked as sorted: the name column on the Summaries and Detail reports, the Date column on Collection and Unpaid Invoices.”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), version of 5 Nov 2026 (1793886208-34e0), read 10 Nov 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html); page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html).
